A black and white time-lapse captures a person creating a large, intricate mural on an interior wall. The mural features swirling, organic patterns and a large, eye-like shape. The artist, wearing dark clothing, is seen working from a tall A-frame ladder, applying paint to the upper sections of the wall. The room has high ceilings, large multi-paned windows, and a track lighting system. A small table with supplies sits in the foreground. Over the sequence, the artist moves around the room, climbing the ladder to reach different heights, and the mural gradually becomes more detailed and complete. The camera remains static, providing a wide view of the entire workspace.
